questions.q: What was Stephen Strange's career before the accident that ruined his hands?
questions.why: Strange was an arrogant neurosurgeon until a car accident ended his surgical career.

questions.q: Which actor has played Doctor Strange in the Marvel Cinematic Universe since 2016?
questions.why: Benedict Cumberbatch has played Strange since Doctor Strange (2016).

questions.q: Which amulet does Strange wear to negate evil magic?
questions.why: The Eye of Agamotto hangs on his chest and is used to negate evil magic.

questions.q: Which artist co-created Doctor Strange with writer Stan Lee?
questions.why: Steve Ditko drew and plotted Strange, with Stan Lee scripting.

questions.q: In which comic did Doctor Strange make his debut in 1963?
questions.why: His debut came in Strange Tales, issue 110, dated July 1963.

questions.q: Which disciple of the Ancient One tried to kill his mentor and became Strange's most enduring enemy?
questions.why: Baron Mordo, the Ancient One's disciple, tried to kill him and became Strange's longest-running foe.

questions.q: Strange's Sanctum Sanctorum stands in which Manhattan neighborhood?
questions.why: His Sanctum Sanctorum is a townhouse in Greenwich Village.

questions.q: Clea is revealed to be the niece of which Dark Dimension ruler?
questions.why: Clea, Strange's love, is Dormammu's niece.

questions.q: In which issue did Strange's eight-page origin story run in December 1963?
questions.why: His eight-page origin story ran in Strange Tales #115, cover-dated December 1963.

questions.q: Which actor starred in the 1978 TV film Dr. Strange?
questions.why: Peter Hooten starred as Strange in the 1978 television film.
